motivation: The completed archival midpoint probe changed only the early 0..10 evaluation resolution: TEN saving was 6.3521% on the historical grid and 7.3196% with dense early evaluation. Low-threshold crossings still used 10-update interpolation. This diagnostic checks both thresholds at one-update resolution and measures the same trajectories on exact-line-filtered English documents. It is not a new efficacy confirmation and cannot rescue either prior FAIL.
initial_weights: Same archived phase1 Students and the single fixed MID50 from r2_measurement_midpoint_exploratory. No new mixing coefficient or method.
training: Replay exactly original English batches/AdamW from phase1 for updates 1..200, fixed before this diagnostic. This horizon covers every historical low-threshold crossing; never extend it based on new observations.

evaluation.historical_sampled: Evaluate the original 8x32 seed-specific English batches at every update 0..200. Compare original-grid NLL values to completed archival probe within 1e-6.
evaluation.clean_document: Evaluate all exact-line-filtered English documents with the fixed per-document 128-byte masked evaluator every five updates 0..200. Apply the already fixed historical reference high/low numerical thresholds to both arms, explicitly labeling this a changed descriptive evaluation.
evaluation.statistics: Report interpolated and discrete first-observed threshold crossings separately. Do not equate fractional update interpolation with physically executed fractional optimizer steps. Report per-seed differences, median/range, and censoring; do not pool these reused seeds as new independent evidence.

stopping: Exactly 30 replay curves, each 200 English updates. No additional model parameters, seeds, coefficients, hypotheses, thresholds or horizons are selected from these outcomes.
midpoint_candidate_gate: The already reported exploratory FAIL is retained; the denser measurement is a diagnostic, not a retrospective replacement.
